description: Records that the software behind a finding from get_vulnerabilities was upgraded: to `version`, or by default to the first version that fixes it (the finding's fix_version). The monitor is checked again; findings that no longer apply disappear, and one that still applies stays, marked with the version. Only records the version; it does not change the server. Free.

version.description: The version installed. Leave out for the first version that fixes it.

name: mark_vulnerability_fixed
title: Mark a vulnerability fixed
